description: Phish triage of five raw .eml files: give each mail a verdict line with a reason keyword (spoofed, pixel, forward-mismatch, lookalike, clean) judged on headers and bodies, plus the exact tracking pixel URL and the mismatched forward-chain address pair.

criteria: The agent parsed headers and bodies of all five mails: 001 clean, 002 spoofed (From says corp.example.com but Return-Path is corp-example-support.com), 003 pixel (tracking pixel URL in the HTML body, clean subject), 004 forward-mismatch (innermost Return-Path billing@vendor-invoices-pay.com vs inner From billing@supplies-vendor.com), 005 lookalike (corp.example-corp.com), and reported the exact pixel URL and the address pair.
